name: matewishkey
description: Shortcuts from Mate Wish Key, for people who have never opened a terminal.

plugins.name: mwk-genie
plugins.description: Five commands for people who are not developers. /mwk-genie:new-project makes a folder in ~/projects with save points and a private GitHub repo. /mwk-genie:save writes down what changed, pushes it, and leaves a note for next time. /mwk-genie:magic steps back and says where the project has drifted. /mwk-genie:learning adds today to a running, printable page of what they have learnt. /mwk-genie:bug writes up a problem with the kit and files it once they agree.
